description: Matco Foods Limited was established in 1964 and produces packed consumer foods and supplies ingredients to the pharmaceutical and confectionery industries. It processes basmati rice — with a plant at Sadhoke — and has added rice glucose and rice protein manufacturing in Karachi, alongside a plant at a Special Economic Zone in Faisalabad.
